summary: Server singleton of the drop-in approval flow: connection requests waiting for the host's approval, as a hash set of esv::multiplayer::PlayerConnectInfo (keyed by the request Guid at +0x58). Filled by DropInApprovalSystem::ProcessApprovalRequests, emptied by ProcessApprovalAnswers; read by esv::JoiningProtocol::SendRefuseMessage (macOS). Seen.py context: idle level, never non-empty.

open_questions: Names of the FixedString at +0, the STDString at +8 and the three bytes at +0x38..+0x3A of PlayerConnectInfo (no named accessor; widths are established).
second_pass: Windows ProcessApprovalRequests (bg3.exe+0x2F38A90) and ProcessApprovalAnswers (bg3.exe+0x2F390C0) confirm the hash set of 0x68-byte PlayerConnectInfo keyed by the Guid at +0x58 and every member width; the 24-byte ExternalCommunityUserID is a kind dword, a type byte and an 8- or 16-byte id (SE's 16-byte Net.h struct is too short). Getter bg3.exe+0x2F3ADF0 is this component's (users of its type index).
